subject.title: fix(agent-runtime): skip unreadable construction tool names

question: Should maintainers refresh and land this construction-plan unreadable-name guard as its own slice, consolidate it with the sibling unreadable-tool-name hardening PRs, or close it after another landed fix covers this helper?
rationale: The PR is maintainer-labeled, draft, and currently conflicting, while related open PRs cover adjacent but not identical surfaces; choosing the landing unit and conflict resolution is a maintainer sequencing decision rather than deterministic cleanup.

options.title: Refresh And Review This Slice
options.body: Rebase or rebuild this PR on current main, keep the readable-name snapshot behavior for this helper, and rerun the focused helper test, scoped lint, and diff check before merge.

options.title: Consolidate The Series
options.body: Fold this helper fix into one broader unreadable-tool-name hardening PR if maintainers want a single coordinated review across agent policy, allowlist, and runtime surfaces.

options.title: Close After A Landed Superseder
options.body: If another merged PR later covers this exact construction allowlist helper, close this PR with that commit as the canonical implementation.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Review This Slice
